dedupe_keys.name: stochlab offshore wind bird collision model

description: stochLAB is an R package from Marine Scotland Science for stochastic collision-risk modelling of seabirds at offshore wind farms. It adapts the Band collision-risk method to represent uncertainty and variation in bird movement, turbine geometry and exposure. Users supply species flight behaviour, bird density and turbine-layout parameters; outputs are collision-risk distributions for the selected wind farm and period. Geographic coverage is a configured offshore site, not a fixed national dataset. The package DESCRIPTION states GPL-3.0 terms and the repository offers examples and documentation. A limitation is that estimated mortality depends on uncertain flight-height and avoidance assumptions, so it should not be treated as observed bird loss. stochLAB can help compare wind-farm layouts alongside energy capacity planning and environmental constraints. The related catalogue PyPSA model concerns power operation, not wildlife collision risk. No bird counts, wind-farm data or R package were downloaded.
